sources.quote: The latest iPhone update is chock-full of smart upgrades, with a big focus on improvements to Siri.
iOS 27 is finally here, with the new Siri AI beta

claims.statement: iOS 27 has been released, with Siri the headline change.

discrepancies.explanation: One outlet's text counts the security patches in the release; the other's describes only the feature changes.

quotes.quote: The latest iPhone update is chock-full of smart upgrades, with a big focus on improvements to Siri.

headline: iOS 27 released with Siri changes and security fixes
summary: Two outlets report the release of iOS 27, both leading on changes to Siri. One describes the update as a set of smart upgrades focused on Siri; the other reports the new Siri AI beta alongside 120 security patches, a figure the first outlet's text does not carry.
